summary: Emergency contacts for Rwanda. Kigali is one of Africa's safest and most organized cities, with responsive emergency services and improving private healthcare. These are the numbers to have saved.

police.notes: Also reachable at +250 788 311 155. Rwanda Police is known for fast response times in Kigali, particularly in Nyarugenge and Kicukiro districts. English-speaking officers widely available.

ambulance.notes: Also reachable at +250 788 303 018. SAMU Rwanda (Service d'Aide Médicale Urgente) handles major medical emergencies. Private hospital ambulances can also be dispatched from King Faisal Hospital.

fire.notes: Also reachable at +250 788 311 177. Response in Kigali is generally reliable.

tourist.description: Rwanda Development Board Tourist Support Line
tourist.notes: Available during business hours. Rwanda has strong tourism infrastructure and an English-speaking service sector.

embassies.name: U.S. Embassy Kigali
embassies.address: 2657 Avenue de la Gendarmerie, Kacyiru, Kigali
embassies.emergencyNote: Call main number and follow the after-hours emergency recording for citizen emergencies

embassies.name: British High Commission Kigali
embassies.address: Parcelle No. 1131, Boulevard de l'Umuganda, Kacyiru, Kigali
embassies.emergencyNote: Call main number for after-hours recording and duty officer access

embassies.name: Canadian High Commission Nairobi (Accredited to Rwanda)
embassies.emergencyNote: Canada does not have a resident High Commission in Kigali. Consular services are handled from Nairobi. Ottawa emergency line available 24/7.

hospitals.name: King Faisal Hospital
hospitals.notes: Rwanda's top referral hospital and de facto best hospital in the country. Excellent emergency care and specialist services. Used by the diplomatic community, government officials, and international visitors. English-speaking staff throughout.

hospitals.name: Clinic Galien
hospitals.notes: Quality private clinic in central Kigali. Good for outpatient care, general consultations, and minor emergencies. Used by expats and business travelers.

hospitals.name: CHUK (University Central Hospital of Kigali)
hospitals.notes: Main public teaching hospital. Handles major trauma and emergency cases. Can be busy but has improving facilities and trained staff.

insurance.nhis: Rwanda's Mutuelle de Santé is the community health insurance scheme for residents. Visitors are not covered. Rwanda has a reputation for affordable, improving healthcare by regional standards.
insurance.recommendation: Carry comprehensive travel insurance. King Faisal Hospital is the gold standard in Kigali and accepts international insurance. Medical evacuation to Nairobi (45-minute flight) or South Africa is available for serious cases requiring advanced care not available locally.

keyAlerts: Dial 112 (police), 912 (ambulance), 111 (fire). Save these before you land
King Faisal Hospital is the best medical facility in Rwanda and should be your first call for any serious emergency
Rwanda has one of Africa's best safety reputations. Crime against tourists is rare but not impossible
Canada does not have a resident mission in Rwanda. Canadians should contact the High Commission in Nairobi or the Ottawa emergency line
English is widely spoken in Kigali's service sector and government institutions. Language barriers are minimal for English speakers

additionalResources.name: AMREF Flying Doctors
additionalResources.description: Medical evacuation from Rwanda to Nairobi or South Africa
